verdict.rationale: The Konnect AI Gateway v1 API reference [docs-14] exposes operation entries with summary and description fields (e.g. 'list-ai-gateways'), which suggests an underlying OpenAPI-style spec rendered as machine-readable markdown. However, the probe found no spec at the standard well-known OpenAPI/Swagger paths on the docs site [probe-3]. That probe covers only generic paths, so it does not contradict the existence of a spec elsewhere; it just leaves downloadability unconfirmed. Missing for 10: an explicit downloadable OpenAPI file or link, a documented spec URL for the AI Gateway APIs, and hands-on confirmation of retrieval.
